browserSearchPath: CLMS Bio-geophysical Parameters, Vegetation, Burnt Area
collectionDescription: This dataset identifies burn scars worldwide on a daily basis, at a spatial resolution of approximately 300 m. In addition to the date of burn, it provides the burnt fraction of each pixel, with quality indicators accompanying both variables.

layers.longDescription: This variable indicates the day of the year on which the burn is detected.

layers.shortDescription: Probability of the classification as burn
layers.longDescription: The confidence probability (CP) quantifies, for each pixel, the likelihood that the burn detected in the Day of Burn layer corresponds to an actual burn. It is derived by comparison with a reference dataset and is expressed as a dimensionless probability between 0 and 1.
This variable gives the fraction of the pixel surface that has been affected by fire.

layers.shortDescription: Probability that the Fraction of Burn area is above 0.1.
layers.longDescription: This indicator expresses the probability that the burnt fraction of the pixel exceeds 0.1, and thus reflects the quality of the burnt fraction reported in the Burnt Fraction layer.
